title: Getting Started: Let Them + Let Me
coreMove: Letting other people live their lives is only half of it. The other half is asking what your own hurt is telling you to actually do next.

exampleSpecs.domain: Source case: Girls' weekend social-media spiral
exampleSpecs.audience: Gustav and readers facing let Them + Let Me
exampleSpecs.stakes: Emotional pain often points to a need for ownership instead of a need to control the people who triggered it.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Gustav using Let Them + Let Me in the source case without controlling another person.
